title: codariocalyx conicus
intro: Codariocalyx conicus, commonly known as "Hog's Fungus", is a species of flowering plant in the family Asclepiadaceae. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Codariocalyx conicus include anti-parasitic, antispasmodic, and expectorant activities, making it a valuable remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Codariocalyx conicus include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
